name: Payment Terminal Parameters 8
definition: Manufacturer configuration parameters of the point of interaction (POI).

ActionType.name: Action Type
ActionType.definition: Type of action for the configuration parameters.

VendorIdentification.name: Vendor Identification
VendorIdentification.definition: Identification of the vendor for the MTM, if the POI manages various subsets of terminal parameters.

ClockSynchronisation.name: Clock Synchronisation
ClockSynchronisation.definition: Parameters to synchronise the real time clock of the POI (Point Of Interaction).

TimeZoneLine.name: Time Zone Line
TimeZoneLine.definition: Time zone line to update in the time zone data base subset stored in the POI (Point Of Interaction). The format of the line is conform to the IANA (Internet Assigned Number Authority) time zone data base.

LocalDateTime.name: Local Date Time
LocalDateTime.definition: Local time offset to UTC (Coordinated Universal Time).

OffsetStart.name: Offset Start
OffsetStart.definition: Place of this  Block, beginning with 0, in the full other parameters.

OffsetEnd.name: Offset End
OffsetEnd.definition: Following place of this Block in the full other parameters.

OtherParameters.name: Other Parameters
OtherParameters.definition: Others manufacturer configuration parameters of the point of interaction.
